hero.headline: Withdraw Your Matured Funds to Your Own Bank Account
hero.subhead: Request before 12 PM on a working day. Your request is processed automatically the same day, and the money reaches your bank by the end of business the next working day. Free of charge.

keyFacts.label: Request By
keyFacts.sub: On a working day, for same-day processing

eod.title: What “End of Business” Means
eod.body: “End of business” (EOD) means the time banks close their books for the day. Money sent to you that day appears in your account by then, not at a fixed hour such as 12 PM or 2 PM. If you are waiting for a withdrawal, please check your bank balance after the bank closes before you contact us.
eod.example: Example: You place a request at 11:30 AM on Sunday. We process it on Sunday, and the money reaches your bank by the end of business on Monday.

items.title: Funds Mature
items.body: Sale proceeds become available (matured) in your BO account on the day your shares settle.

items.title: Place Your Request
items.body: Use one of the forms above before 12 PM on a working day. Requests placed later are processed on the next working day.

items.title: Automatic Processing
items.body: The system processes your request. There is no manual approval step and nothing more to do.

items.title: Money in Your Bank
items.body: The money is sent to your registered bank account by BEFTN and arrives by the end of business the next working day.

request.title: Request a Withdrawal
request.intro: Choose the way that matches you. Your money is always sent to the bank account registered with your BO account.

portal.title: I Have a Portal Account
portal.body: Use your client code and Midway Portal password.
portal.note: Only enter your password on this page or the Midway Portal. Never send it on WhatsApp or by phone.

manual.title: I Do Not Have a Portal Account
manual.body: Fill in the form and we will process it manually.
manual.note: [Manual requests: processing time to be confirmed.]

rtgs.title: RTGS Withdrawal: Money in About 10 Minutes
rtgs.body: We are testing RTGS withdrawals for larger amounts. RTGS is Bangladesh Bank’s real-time system: during banking hours the money reaches your bank account in up to 10 minutes.
rtgs.note: RTGS is a pilot and may change. For smaller amounts, use the standard BEFTN withdrawal above.

account.title: Your Bank Account
items: Money goes to the bank account you used to open your BO account.
You can change your bank account at any time in the Midway Portal.
The account must always be in your own name.

items.q: When can I withdraw my money?
items.a: Once your funds are matured. After you sell shares, the money becomes available (matured) in your BO account on the day your shares settle.

items.q: How long does a withdrawal take?
items.a: Place your request before 12 PM on a working day. It is processed the same day, and the money reaches your bank account by the end of business the next working day. Requests placed after 12 PM are processed on the next working day.

items.q: What does end of business mean?
items.a: It is the time banks close their books for the day. Your money arrives in your account by then, not at a fixed hour. Please check your balance after the bank closes.

items.q: What if my money is late?
items.a: First check your bank balance after the bank closes, because money arrives by the end of business on the next working day. Delays can come from the banking network, which is outside Midway’s control. If the bank details on file are wrong, the transfer can fail, so check them in the Midway Portal, where you can also see the status of every request.
No. There are no limits on standard withdrawals. The RTGS pilot has a minimum of ৳1,00,000.
No. Withdrawals from Midway are free.
The registered bank account you used to open your BO account. You can change it in the Midway Portal, but it must always be your own bank account.

items.q: Do I need to approve or follow up on my request?
items.a: No. Withdrawals are fully automated. Once you place a request, nothing more is needed.

items.q: Can I withdraw without a Portal account?
items.a: Yes. Use the manual form on this page and we will process it manually.
A test program for larger withdrawals. RTGS is Bangladesh Bank’s real-time system, and during banking hours the money reaches your bank account in up to 10 minutes. The minimum is ৳1,00,000.
